head: 70862a71dfaf2b00694dc1354c6a64e9504d7db5
reason: No consecutive-view finality edge and unfinalized chain exceeds 8-descendant proof bound
normal_pow: NOT_RUN: available memory below 32GiB DAG + cache + node requirements

acceptance.scope: start/final-live-observation.json. Mapped the designated host/branch and parent-child relationships, executables, and datadirs for 14 CLX/Common processes, seven sidecars, and two relays. All 14 share the new genesis.

Operated only the seven target Commons and two relays. All seven committee PIDs were unchanged. No out-of-scope PM2 application was involved. Chain ID, genesis, initialization, and normal binaries were unchanged in this work.

dex-stop-isolation.json. Gracefully stopped seven owned sidecars and normally restarted seven Commons with the same DBs. Old parent/child PIDs were gone; each had one sidecar with matching inode/manifest/checkpoint. The initial missing-directory FAIL was retained separately.
All 23 running executables matched release 76d2d104…. All 600 production source files also matched the existing build manifest. No normal binary was redeployed in this work.

Started real TLS for seven Common-side participants with unique manifests/DBs/voting keys. CLX committee engine counters were zero. Fixed epoch 1 on one host; this is neither public admission nor WAN operation.

LIVE observations covered RPC+DEX, Common PoW OFF, and stopping all DEX children. A complete rerun of all eight combinations and normal PoW were not performed. Previous ISOLATED lifecycle PASS is a separate record.

Four native deposits passed through ordinary signed TX/Common admission/CLX finality and outer authentication reconciliation: PASS(LIVE). Heavy counters were zero on all 14 CLX processes. The LIVE DEX checkpoint/claim path remained blocked at finality 0.

225 native CLX were deposited, but DEX was certified 15/finalized 0/inbox 0. LIVE financial integration of orders/fills/participation reward reservations remained incomplete. See finality-wal-chain.json and the reproduction test.
Payments 0, reservations 0. No unauthenticated funds were paid. Prerequisites for complete LIVE financial claim/replay/cold-restart tests were unmet.

Existing hot-128/cut-64 implementation and historical UNIT results were retained. The full storage-rotation acceptance suite was not rerun. A separate finality stop at the eight-descendant proof bound was discovered.
All DEX storage generations were 0. Prerequisites for the LIVE financial test with two rotations at actual settings were unmet.

Restoring existing certified checkpoints from the same DB passed LIVE. The new backlog reproduction retained votes/locks/QCs/timeouts: PASS(UNIT). LIVE continuity of all rights, including unpaid claims, was not tested.
Ordinary CLX transfers during the complete DEX stop and same-DB recovery passed LIVE, with independent FHS/MPT/inclusion checks. Draining financial unsettled work after a CLX stop was not tested.
Only A/B/C runner unit tests and the offline plan were completed. Measured comparison was not run because financial prerequisites failed. Performance acceptance is undetermined.
The requested five-minute short drive failed partway through. It did not complete 60 minutes of mixed finance, two storage generations, or financial settlement after downtime.

Observed MemAvailable was about 23.98–25.09 GiB, insufficient for a normal 32 GiB DAG plus 512 MiB cache and node resources. Nonce exploration/delivery/adoption/rewards were not tested. DAG, difficulty, and OS settings were unchanged.

The new LIVE finality failure remained unfixed. Final Python 78 tests, finance/source helper race eight top-level tests, four financial packages/60 tests, the existing 225→214 fixture, and backlog reproduction/race passed UNIT. Initial harness FAILs were retained. Two historical forkid and three RPC failures were neither fixed nor rerun.

The new generation after owner-performed init was observed. init.sh was neither modified nor executed in this work. Post-completion final init was not performed. Keeping the same chain ID does not isolate ordinary signed-transaction replay.

At completion, 14 CLX processes were online and seven DEX participants active; two relays were intentionally stopped. Recorded CLX 1121 with matching roots, DEX 15/0/accepted 0, custody 225, payments/reservations 0, and generation 0.

Mapped final source/build/configuration/run/public raw logs to the review archive, excluding keys/runtime. Starting git status, release-source comparison, and per-helper manifests were retained. There is no record of a new complete starting-diff archive; that capture is reported as not performed.

tests.finality_backlog_and_gap_race: PASS(UNIT): fail-closed/restart; LIVE liveness remains FAIL
